text: Target food cost is <= 30% of menu price for every dish. #cost
Always label [[allergens]] — nuts, gluten, dairy, and shellfish — on every dish, without exception. #allergens
Prefer [[seasonal]] sourcing to reduce ingredient cost and improve freshness. #cost #quality
Every menu must include at least one [[vegan]] and one [[halal]] option per service period. #dietary
Standard portion sizes: protein 150–180 g, starch 120 g, vegetables 100 g per plate. #portioning
Track [[supplier]] [[lead-time]] before finalising a menu; flag any item with a lead-time over 48 hours. #operations
Rotate the menu every 7 days to limit over-ordering and reduce [[waste]]. #operations #cost
When suggesting ingredient swaps, preserve the dish's flavour profile and presentation quality, not just the price. #quality
